under5.t: Hello there! Wiggle wiggle, I'm so happy to see you.
Hi little friend, can you wave? Yay!
Rattle rattle, what a nice costume I see.
Boo! Hehe, that was a silly boo.
Clackety-clack, let's say hello together.
Hiya! One, two, three, big smiles!
Oh no, my funny bone fell off again.
Hello hello! You make my bones feel warm.
Giggle with me, wiggle wiggle wiggle!
Hi there, can you give a tiny wave? Yay!
Rattle rattle, you're such a good visitor.
A gentle boo turns into happy giggles.
Clackety-clack, what fun to meet you.
Hiccup! Oops, silly skeleton hiccups.
Hello friend, let's count to three: one, two, three!
Wiggle wiggle, I love your happy face.
Hi hi! My bones are dancing for you.
Rattle rattle, you're safe and welcome here.
Boo! Hehe, now we both laugh together.
Clackety-clack, can you say hello back? Yay!
Oh dear, my elbow bone is tickling me.
Hello little one, big warm hello to you.
One, two, three, let's all giggle now.
Hiccup! Excuse my silly skeleton burps.
Wiggle wiggle, your smile makes me shine.
Rattle rattle, what a sweet friend you are.
Hi there! Can you wave high? Yay!
Gentle boo into the happiest giggles.
Clackety-clack, come say hi anytime.
Hello hello, my bones are full of joy for you.

5to10.t: Hey there, bonehead! Ready for a spooktacular treat?
Trick or treat? I've got a funny bone just for you!
Whoa, what a crew! Let's rattle up some fun tonight!
I'm all bones and no brains, but I've got candy for days!
Knock knock! It's your favorite bag of bones!
Hehe, you caught me ribbing around—happy Halloween!
Don't be skullish, grab some goodies and go!
My hollow ribcage is empty but my spirit's full of fun!
Bone voyage, little ghouls—happy haunting!
I'm just a skeleton but I've got a heart of gold... somewhere!
Shake your bones and say boo! Candy's waiting!
You've got me tickled to the marrow—welcome!
No guts, no glory, but plenty of sweets here!
I'm humerus-ly happy to see you tonight!
Rattle those feet and come get a treat, kiddo!
Spooky? Nah, just silly bones throwing candy!
My big appetite is all for fun—take a treat!
tibia honest, you're looking awesome tonight!
One skeleton, zero stomach, endless Halloween cheer!
Let's make this night femurtastic!
Boo to you! From one bony friend to another!
Stick around and I'll tell another pun—I've got a skele-ton of 'em!
No spine? No problem—I've got treats instead!
You're looking skull-tastic, little monster!
I've got a bone to pick... with who wants candy first!
Joint the party, it's Halloween o'clock!
My ribs are tickled pink—or should I say orange?
Don't be a numbskull, come say hello!
Skeleton crew reporting for treat duty!
Happy Halloween—you're the highlight of my afterlife!

11to15.t: Nice eye roll, kid. Save it for when your phone dies.
Oh look, another too-cool zombie. Trick or treat yourself to some enthusiasm.
Phone out already? Congrats, you just lost the vibe.
"This is so lame" — said every kid who still wants candy.
Keep rolling those eyes, maybe you'll find a personality in there.
Acting like you're above this? Buddy, you're literally at my door.
Wow, the over-it energy is strong with this one. Next.
Mouthy at eleven? Can't wait to see you at sixteen, still empty-handed.
Put the phone down before I start roasting your playlist.
Too cool to say hello? Cool, then you're too cool for my Snickers.
Eye-rolling that hard might pull a muscle. Relax.
"This is lame" — famous last words before the door shuts.
Sass level high, candy level dropping fast. Choose wisely.
Over-it already? Halloween just started, pace yourself.
Acting like my porch is beneath you? Bold strategy, cotton.
Keep pretending you're too old for this and watch me believe you.
Phones out, attitude up — classic move for kids who still want free stuff.
That half-heckle was weak. Try harder or take the candy and go.
Too cool to smile? That's fine, your loss on the good bars.
Eye rolls don't unlock the good candy bowl, just so you know.
Mouthy and over-it — the two fastest ways to get fun-size only.
Save the attitude for your group chat. I'm not impressed.
"This is so lame" coming from the kid begging at skeleton doors. Irony.
Roll your eyes one more time and I'll match your energy with the door.
Too cool for Halloween? Then why are you here, trendsetter?
That unimpressed face is working real hard for free chocolate.
Acting like this is beneath you while reaching for my candy — cute.
Over-it at your age? Wait till you're my age, then we'll talk.
Phone's more interesting than a talking skeleton? Bold, but wrong.
Keep that energy up and the only thing you'll get is a better story for your friends about how a skeleton shut you down.

teens.t: Nice hoodie, kid — did your "I'm too cool for Halloween" costume come with the eye-roll, or did you add that yourself? Here's some candy anyway.
Ah, the classic "hoodie and regret" ensemble. Aren't you a little old for this? Just kidding, take some candy.
Look at you, half-effort legend. Most teens quit at your age; respect for showing up. Candy's yours.
That costume's so lazy it needs a nap. Good thing my candy bowl doesn't judge.
Trick-or-treating at your age? Bold. Most your friends are out pretending they're too cool for this. Candy for the effort.
Hoodie game strong, costume game... nonexistent. Still, skeleton approves. Grab some sweets.
"Too cool for this" walks up to a talking skeleton. Irony called, it wants its candy back. Here you go.
I see the half-effort uniform is back in style. Don't worry, the candy's fully committed.
Aren't you a little old to be ringing random doorbells? Nah, who am I kidding — candy's on the house.
That costume took you what, thirty whole seconds? Impressive. Enjoy the sugar rush.
The "I swear I'm just here for my little sibling" vibe is strong tonight. Candy regardless.
Hood up, enthusiasm down. Classic teen move. Lucky for you, this skeleton's generous.
You rolled up looking like you lost a bet with laziness. Candy makes it all better.
Too cool to dress up, yet here you are begging a skeleton for treats. Love the consistency. Take some.
Your costume's basically "incognito teenager." Bold strategy. Candy for the comedy.
I was going to say you're too old for this, but then I remembered I'm a pile of bones. Here, have some.
Half a costume and full confidence. That's rarer than a honest politician. Candy's yours.
The hoodie says "I'm over this," but your hand in my candy bowl says otherwise. Enjoy.
Nice try blending in with the actual children. Almost worked. Almost. Candy anyway.
That costume's so minimal it might file for unemployment. Good thing candy's free.
Aren't you supposed to be out toilet-papering houses by now? Or is that next on the list? Take some treats.
The "I threw this together in the dark" look is really working for you. Skeleton seal of approval and candy.
You showed up like Halloween owes you money. Fortunately I'm in a giving mood.
Too cool for a real costume, yet not too cool for free candy. I respect the math. Here you go.
That hoodie is pulling overtime while your costume clocks out early. Candy for the dedication.
I see the annual "I'm just accompanying friends" excuse is alive and well. Candy for all.
Your effort level is inspiring...ly low. Still, a talking skeleton can't complain. Sweets inbound.
Look who decided to grace the porch with their too-cool presence. Candy, with a side of sarcasm.
The "barely tried" costume hall of fame just called — you're their new MVP. Enjoy the haul.
Showing up at my door at your age takes guts. Or maybe just hunger. Either way, candy's waiting.
